reference: Original DOS6 bios/msint13.asm; full selected module reviewed, including INT 2F Windows/HMA services and INT 13 DMA/ECC paths.
changes: Resolve 43 DOS7_CONFIG selectors and discard inactive DOS6 alternatives. Remove orphan HMAPtr and deleted-variable headers. Return INT 2F and move_sector headers to their actual procedures after intervening data. Normalize PUBLIC indentation and correct far-buffer comments; move BYTE_SYSINIT below original header.
necessity: Windows initialization tables and keyboard/video multiplex services extend the original INT 2F owner; they are not NT/BOP code. HMA allocation/free operations are distinct services sharing the existing block search. Extended-read ECC recovery consumes a disk address packet; original CHS recovery consumes register geometry, so both are required. Keep common move_sector/check_wrap/find_bds/doint helpers and avoid a second module or replacement implementation.
preserved: Complete original common DMA/ECC handling, hardware workarounds, historical comments, raw cmp encodings, external/public interfaces, resident data layout, CPU directives and stack-return paths.

validation.reason: All 1092 effective statements remain identical in order and literal values. No instruction/data/segment/link change.
validation.binary_baseline: P11 accepted BIOS/IO.SYS and T11 accepted COMMAND.COM/MSDOS.SYS remain applicable.
